description: Public police-recorded crime statistics registry and boundary provenance

datasets.title: District-Wise IPC Crimes in Delhi (2013)
datasets.publisher: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
datasets.granularity: Delhi Police Districts (11 territorial units + 7 specialized/railway units)
datasets.audit_notes: Preserves original NCRB column headers alongside normalized indicators. Distinguishes territorial police districts from specialized units (CAW, Crime Branch, EOW, GRP, Metro, IGI, STF).

datasets.title: Annual IPC Crime Trends in Delhi (2013–2022)
datasets.publisher: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
datasets.granularity: National Capital Territory of Delhi (State/UT Level)
datasets.source_file: Official NCRB Crime in India Compendia (2013-2022)
datasets.audit_notes: Documents critical administrative shifts: 2014 e-FIR registration portal launch, 2017 district bifurcation, and 2020 pandemic lockdown impacts.

datasets.title: Delhi Revenue & Administrative District Boundaries
datasets.publisher: Survey of India (SOI) / National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC)
datasets.granularity: 11 Revenue Districts (Central, East, New Delhi, North, North East, North West, Shahdara, South, South East, South West, West)
datasets.completeness: 11 of 11 administrative revenue districts present with valid polygon geometry
datasets.audit_notes: Important: Police districts and Revenue districts are not 1:1 coterminous. For example, Shahdara was created administratively in 2012 but was not reported as a separate police district in the 2013 NCRB report; Outer is a police district with no direct revenue district counterpart.
